findings.title: Gone in 8 Seconds: Uncovering the Malicious Bots Operating on Public Container Registries (study artifact)
findings.summary_md: Zenodo hosts an artifact for the Stony Brook study by Billy Tsouvalas and Nick Nikiforakis, titled Gone in 8 Seconds: Uncovering the Malicious Bots Operating on Public Container Registries. The record's publication date is 14 September 2026, which places the underlying measurement work in public view well before the November news coverage. It is research material rather than an advisory, but it establishes the study's title, authors and early public availability.

findings.title: Gone in 8 Seconds: Uncovering Malicious Bots Operating on Public Container Registries
findings.summary_md: The ACM proceedings record dates this paper online to 14 November 2026 and places it in the Proceedings of the 2026 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security. Its authors are Billy Tsouvalas and Nick Nikiforakis of Stony Brook University. The paper is the primary source for the honeypot experiment described in the later news coverage, and its publication date predates that coverage.
